title: Surya Kavach Rakhi — Gold Mandala with Ruby and Sapphire Beads
shortDescription: A hand-finished gold mandala centre, flanked by deep ruby and sapphire beads on a red silk thread.
description:
The centre is a sunburst mandala — the kind carved onto old temple doors — pressed in gold tone and finished by hand so no two catch the light quite the same way.

On either side sit ruby-red and sapphire-blue glass beads, held between gold caps, on a twisted red silk thread that ends in full tassels. It sits flat on the wrist and does not catch on a sleeve.

Comes in a gift box, ready to send.
